svg.title: MAP-ENV-001 GM Controlled Local Schematic v001
svg.desc: North-up, non-metric candidate local schematic. Only GEO-000003, GEO-000004, GEO-000007, GEO-000009 and ROUTE-000001 through ROUTE-000004 / GXR-000010 through GXR-000013 are in scope. ROUTE-000001 and ROUTE-000002 line geometry and sight lines are PROPOSED. ROUTE-000003 and ROUTE-000004 remain non-geometric. No wall footprint, terrain, distance, travel time, scale, road width, choke point, or unregistered geography is established.

CONTROL NOTES
Candidate geometry only
• ROUTE-000001 and ROUTE-000002 remain RELATIONAL ONLY
until this local layout is approved.
• The two candidate routes do not share a segment or junction.
This is a proposal, not a rule for future revisions.
• O-G and O-L are positive proposed observation positions.
No claim is made that other points can or cannot see either target.
• No occlusion model is supplied. Unknown blockers are not invented.
• Zero choke points is the current candidate result.
No choke point is added for dramatic or investigative convenience.
• Principal-gate marker is a functional endpoint, not a wall-face claim.
• Last-Bell marker is an anchor, not a footprint/property boundary.
• Tarl Yard is contextual only; ROUTE-000004 is not drawn.
• ROUTE-000003 remains operationally established but physically unknown.
• No numeric distance, travel time, road width, map scale, grid, or hex.
• No terrain, vegetation, ditch, ravine, bridge, ford, stream, or extra structure.
• Unknown local space is intentionally blank.
• No B2, Mystara, or external-source arrangement supplies geometry.
LINE LEGEND
PROPOSED ROUTE-000001
PROPOSED ROUTE-000002
PROPOSED positive sight line
GEO anchor / observation marker
relational context only
REVIEW QUESTION
Approve, reject, or modify the candidate ROUTE-000001/000002 shapes
and O-G / O-L positive visibility relationships. No other geometry advances.
